title: MPESB Patwari Special Recruitment Examination 2026 Online Form
description: MPESB Group-02 Subgroup-04 Patwari Special Recruitment Examination 2026: vacancy, dates, fee, age limit, eligibility, exam pattern and official links.
organization: Madhya Pradesh Employees Selection Board (MPESB), Bhopal
short_info: MPESB has issued the Group-02 Subgroup-04 Combined Recruitment Examination-2026 rulebook for Patwari Special Recruitment Examination (PwD Category). The rulebook lists 200 Patwari posts.
notice: This Patwari Special Recruitment Examination is for the PwD category. The rulebook states that all 200 posts are advertised as UR/NIL/OPEN and that applicants from all categories may apply. Aadhaar registration is mandatory; carry the prescribed original photo identity document and Aadhaar / e-Aadhaar / Aadhaar details for the examination.
fee: Madhya Pradesh domicile SC / ST / OBC / EWS / PwD candidates: Rs. 250/-
MP Online portal charge when applying through an online application kiosk: Rs. 60/- extra
Portal charge when a registered citizen user logs in and fills the form: Rs. 20/-

age_limit.relaxation: For permanent residents of Madhya Pradesh, as per the rulebook and applicable Madhya Pradesh Government orders.

qualification: All 200 posts are advertised as UR/NIL/OPEN; applicants from all categories may apply.
The rulebook gives the district-wise vacancy table for these PwD-category posts.
Indian citizen and a local resident of Madhya Pradesh.
Bachelor's degree from a recognized university.

CPCT certificate with Hindi typing and computer proficiency is mandatory. If a selected candidate has not passed CPCT, it must be passed within the 3-year probation period after appointment; otherwise the appointment will be cancelled.
Valid disability-category certificate issued by the competent authority and registration in Madhya Pradesh employment registration are mandatory.

vacancy.qualification: As listed in the rulebook vacancy table.
As listed in the rulebook vacancy table.
As listed in the rulebook vacancy table.

eligibility: Indian citizen and a local resident of Madhya Pradesh.
Bachelor's degree from a recognized university.

CPCT certificate with Hindi typing and computer proficiency is mandatory for the Patwari selection examination. If a selected candidate has not passed CPCT, it must be passed within the 3-year probation period after appointment; otherwise the appointment will be cancelled.
Valid disability-category certificate issued by the competent authority.
Registration in Madhya Pradesh employment registration is mandatory for applying online.
selection_process: Only candidates obtaining at least 40% of the prescribed total marks will be included in the successful candidates list.
Candidates must indicate district preferences in the application; district preferences cannot be changed after submission.
MPESB will allot the district on merit and the district preferences entered in the application; the merit list is the first counselling selection list.
After document verification, eligible candidates will undergo one counselling process in the allotted district.

exam_pattern.stage: Paper I — General Science, General Hindi, General English and General Mathematics
Paper I — General Knowledge and Aptitude, General Computer Knowledge, General Logical Ability and General Management

important_instructions: Bring one prescribed original photo identity document to the examination: voter ID, PAN card, Aadhaar card, driving licence or passport. e-Aadhaar is valid only after UIDAI verification.

Bring Aadhaar card / e-Aadhaar card / Aadhaar copy / Aadhaar number / Aadhaar VID details. Biometric verification is mandatory at entry and during the examination; Aadhaar must be unlocked for verification.
Entry is permitted only up to the reporting time. Mobile phones, calculators, log tables, digital watches, sunglasses and copying material are prohibited in the examination room.
Carry a black ballpoint pen and the admit card downloaded from the Board website.

faq.question: MPESB Patwari Special Recruitment Examination 2026 में कितने पद हैं?
faq.answer: Rulebook में Patwari (PwD Category) के कुल 200 पद दिए गए हैं: EH 94, LD 45 और MD 61।

faq.question: MPESB Patwari 2026 के लिए आवेदन कब से कब तक है?
MPESB Patwari 2026 की आयु सीमा क्या है?
faq.answer: मध्य प्रदेश के स्थायी निवासियों के लिए आयु सीमा 01/01/2026 को 18 से 45 वर्ष है।

faq.question: MPESB Patwari 2026 के लिए योग्यता क्या है?
faq.answer: भारतीय नागरिक और मध्य प्रदेश का स्थानीय निवासी होना, मान्यता प्राप्त विश्वविद्यालय से स्नातक उपाधि, तथा Hindi typing और computer proficiency सहित CPCT certificate आवश्यक है। सक्षम प्राधिकारी का दिव्यांगता प्रमाण-पत्र और मध्य प्रदेश रोजगार पंजीयन भी आवश्यक है।

faq.question: MPESB Patwari 2026 की परीक्षा कब होगी?
faq.answer: Rulebook के अनुसार परीक्षा 22/09/2026, मंगलवार से प्रारंभ होगी।

faq.question: MPESB Patwari 2026 में न्यूनतम अर्हता अंक कितने हैं?
faq.answer: सफल उम्मीदवारों की सूची में शामिल होने के लिए निर्धारित कुल अंकों में कम से कम 40 प्रतिशत अंक आवश्यक हैं।
